Guests still ask about the name now and then, usually in the middle of a hot Hoi An summer.

The Larch House actually began in the winter of 2011, high up in the cold mist of Sa Pa: a warm fire, simple comfort food, and a room of travellers who stayed a little longer than they meant to.

When we went looking for a second home in 2015, we had a few cities in mind. Then we found a tired old house in Hoi An, booked a flight within days, and opened the doors that October.

Eleven years later the front of the house looks much the same, and so does the idea behind it.
